messages:
liz: Heads up — ran a targeted replay for tenant test-123 (to backfill missing token events) and the invoice preview jumped ~4x. Suspect double-counting from overlapping replay window + late ingest events :warning:
aj: yikes. did you run with dedupe enabled? which dedupe key?
liz: it was the dry-run path (no final write) but the preview path uses the same aggregation logic. dedupe_key was `request_fingerprint`, idempotency window defaulted to 30s. logs show overlapping sessions with different session_id headers.
kevin: that's the classic replay vs live-ingest race. replay replays events in ingestion order; if a late live event arrives after replay, our dedupe window might not catch because key differs.
maria: can you paste the preview diff? small is fine.
liz: gist = https://internal.redwood/gists/abc123 (snip). key lines:
```
aggregate: {
  tenant: "test-123",
  tokens_old: 1245,
  tokens_replayed: 4680,
  preview_total: 5925
}
replay_context: {
  mode: "parallel-replay",
  dedupe_key: "request_fingerprint",
  idempotency_ms: 30000
}
```
kevin: two immediate options: 1) gate replays by rate and run sequentially per-tenant; 2) strengthen dedupe heuristics (include timestamp-range, session_id fallback). both need console/telemetry and a gradual rollout.
billing-ops: we need a short-term safety: pause any production replays and mark affected tenants. we can't surface 4x preview to customers.
aj: agree. propose default gating: max_replay_rate_per_tenant = 1 batch/s and global_replay_concurrency = 5. also add a preflight cost-estimate step that flags >1.5x delta vs last invoice.
ankit: we also need metrics: replay_applied_events, replay_conflicts, replay_estimated_cost_ratio, replay_active_tenants. dashboard panel + alert if replay_estimated_cost_ratio > 2 for >5m.
sre-bot: deploy-checklist generated: /deploy checklist for metering-replay-gate v1 -> https://internal.redwood/tasks/9876 :white_check_mark:
liz: proposed config snippet for ops to apply to the replay controller:
```
replay_controller:
  per_tenant:
    max_batches_per_sec: 1
    allow_parallel_sessions: false
  dedupe:
    primary_key: request_fingerprint
    fallback_keys: [session_id, user_agent]
    window_ms: 120000
  cost_estimation:
    preflight_threshold_ratio: 1.5
    dry_run_only_if_above_threshold: true
```
kevin: looks good. we should also add a console UX change: when someone schedules a backfill/replay, show an inline cost delta estimate and the gating controls (rate slider + checkbox to allow override with justification). that prevents accidental spikes from self-service.
maria: will product/console own the UX or should this be an infra flag + API change?
aj: infra owns API and enforcement. console needs to call the preflight endpoint and show the estimate; product/console will do the UI. I'll add a small API: `POST /v1/metering/replay/preflight` -> returns {estimated_cost_ratio, conflicts_sample}.
liz: timeline? we should at least flip a soft gate (dry-run-only for >1.5x) by EOD for safety.
billing-ops: approved for emergency soft gate. if you push a change, mention on #billing channel.
ankit: I'll add the metrics and a Grafana dashboard. quick queries:
- replay_conflicts = sum(rate(metering_replay_conflict_total[5m]))
- replay_est_cost_ratio = sum(metering_replay_estimated_tokens)/sum(metering_last_month_tokens)
I'll create alert rules: >2 for 5m -> P2, >3 for 1m -> P1.
kevin: rollout plan: 1) infra: add preflight API + gating hooks (can be toggled via feature flag) 2) add metrics + dashboard 3) console: preflight UI + rate slider 4) rollout feature-flag to 10% tenants (non-prod) -> 50% -> all.
liz: I can own step 3 with product. aj + ankit, can you split infra/metrics tasks and tag me on PRs?
aj: will do. tagging here: @ankit @kevin
ankit: starting on the Grafana panels now. ETA 2 days.
kevin: I'll sketch the preflight API and add tests for idempotency windows.
liz: thanks all. immediate action: pause scheduled replays in prod and enable emergency soft gate (dry-run-only if est_ratio >1.5). billing-ops, pls confirm when you see the gate active.
billing-ops: confirmed — paused pending infra rollout. once soft gate is live we'll re-evaluate replays for the backlog. :thumbsup:
aj: logging note: please enrich replay traces with `source = console|api|manual-script` so we can attribute origin of spikes.
liz: done — adding to PR description.
kevin: also remember to add e2e test that simulates late live ingest arriving during replay to validate dedupe changes.
ankit: filed task MET-2345 for the e2e.
liz: good thread — we'll sync in 30m on call if anyone needs deep-dive.
